component.name: DogGame
component.script:
sub init() m.W = LumenTheme().gameW m.H = LumenTheme().gameH m.ground = 300 m.dw = 123 m.dh = 92
kitInit("dog") ' Van Gogh's sunflower field: the horizon sits a little above the middle of the stage. sky = m.top.createChild("Poster") sky.uri = "pkg:/images/wall/wall_sunflower.jpg" sky.width = m.W sky.height = m.W * 9 / 16 sky.translation = [0, -200] m.wheat = kitStrip(m.top, "pkg:/images/games/wheat_vg.png", 1400, 84, m.H - 84)
m.stacks = m.top.createChild("Group") m.pool = [] for i = 0 to 5 p = m.stacks.createChild("Poster") p.uri = "pkg:/images/games/haystack.png" p.visible = false m.pool.Push({ p: p, x: 0.0, w: 0, h: 0, used: false }) end for
m.shadow = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.shadow.uri = "pkg:/images/games/shadow.png" m.shadow.width = 100 m.shadow.height = 18
frames = [] for i = 0 to 3 frames.Push("pkg:/images/games/dog_run_" + i.ToStr() + ".png") end for frames.Push("pkg:/images/games/dog_jump.png") m.dog = kitSprite(m.top, frames, m.dw, m.dh) reset() end sub
sub reset() for each s in m.pool s.used = false s.p.visible = false end for m.x = 120 m.y = m.ground - m.dh m.vy = 0 m.onGround = true m.dist = 0 m.speed = 300 m.nextStack = 420 m.anim = 0 place() kitFrame(m.dog, 0) end sub
sub place() m.dog.g.translation = [m.x, m.y] ' The shadow stays on the ground and shrinks as the pup rises. lift = (m.ground - m.dh - m.y) / 160.0 if lift < 0 then lift = 0 if lift > 0.6 then lift = 0.6 m.shadow.scale = [1 - lift, 1 - lift] m.shadow.translation = [m.x + 10 + 50 * lift, m.ground - 10] end sub
sub begin() end sub
sub action(k as string) if k = "OK" and m.onGround m.vy = -700 m.onGround = false end if end sub
sub addStack(x as float) for each s in m.pool if not s.used s.used = true s.w = 64 + Rnd(36) s.h = s.w * 92 / 128 s.x = x s.p.width = s.w s.p.height = s.h s.p.translation = [s.x, m.ground - s.h + 6] s.p.visible = true return end if end for end sub
sub advance(dt as float) if not m.onGround m.vy = m.vy + 2100 * dt m.y = m.y + m.vy * dt if m.y >= m.ground - m.dh m.y = m.ground - m.dh m.vy = 0 m.onGround = true end if kitFrame(m.dog, 4) else m.anim = m.anim + dt * m.speed / 300.0 kitFrame(m.dog, Int(m.anim / 0.08) mod 4) end if place()
m.speed = m.speed + 10 * dt if m.speed > 620 then m.speed = 620 m.dist = m.dist + m.speed * dt m.top.points = Int(m.dist / 16) kitScroll(m.wheat, m.speed * dt)
m.nextStack = m.nextStack - m.speed * dt if m.nextStack <= 0 addStack(m.W) ' Now and then a pair; spacing grows with speed so every jump stays fair. if Rnd(5) = 1 then addStack(m.W + 80) m.nextStack = (360 + Rnd(320)) * m.speed / 300.0 end if
hit = false for each s in m.pool if s.used s.x = s.x - m.speed * dt s.p.translation = [s.x, m.ground - s.h + 6] if kitHit(m.x + 22, m.y + 18, m.dw - 40, m.dh - 26, s.x + 10, m.ground - s.h + 16, s.w - 20, s.h) then hit = true if s.x + s.w < -10 s.used = false s.p.visible = false end if end if end for if hit then kitOver() end sub
